instructions: LightCraft is a non-destructive photo library and raw developer (a Lightroom alternative). Photos have integer ids; most editing acts on the *active* photo (`set_develop`, `crop` and `export` with an explicit photo id end the current edit interaction, replace the selection with that one photo and make it active; `get_develop` and `render_photo` do not change the selection). Typical loop: query_photos → select_photos (or pass id) → list_controls → set_develop {values: {"light.exposure": 0.5}} → render_preview to look at the result → export. Positions (crop rects, mask points, brush strokes) are normalized image coordinates 0..1 with the origin at the top-left. Every action is a command: command_list shows ids and parameter docs; command_run {id, params} runs any of them; command_batch runs steps in order. Inspect with doc_inspect. Edits are undoable (undo / redo). Backend: headless.

tools.description: Evaluate Face Recognition (command `faces.evaluate`). Params: {budgetMs?: 0, burstSecs?: 5, margin?, thresholds?: [..], scope?: "visible"} → {queries, top1, sweep: [{threshold, suggested, correct, precision, recall}]} — leave-one-out over your named faces: each is ranked against the others (ignoring shots within burstSecs of it) to show how well the chosen model recognises people in *your* photos and which threshold to trust. Faces not yet embedded are done within budgetMs (`faces.index` does them all); counts only.

tools.name: cmd_faces_index
tools.description: Index Faces (command `faces.index`). Params: {budgetMs?: 200, ids?: [photo ids to do first]} → {embedded, photosDone, pendingPhotos, indexedFaces, ms} — embed the faces in the library with the chosen recognition model, as many photos as fit in the time (at least one); call again until `pendingPhotos` is 0. `budgetMs: 0` only reports.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_download
tools.description: Download Face Model (command `faces.models.download`). Params: {id, acknowledged: true} → {started, from} — fetch a recognition model LightCraft has a pinned address for (see `downloadHost` in the list), in the background over pure-Rust https (lightcraft-fetch). `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown the model's terms and accepted them. It is checked against its size and SHA-256, then installed, chosen and switched on by itself; `faces.models.downloads` shows how far it is.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_downloadCancel
tools.description: Cancel Face Model Download (command `faces.models.downloadCancel`). Params: {id} → {discarded} — stop a download, or delete a finished one that was not installed.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_downloads
tools.description: Face Model Downloads (command `faces.models.downloads`). Params: {} → {running, downloads: [{id, state: running | done | installed | failed | cancelled, bytes, total, error, from}]} — also installs any download that has arrived; `installed` stays listed until `faces.models.downloadCancel` clears it.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_inspect
tools.description: Inspect Face Model File (command `faces.models.inspect`). Params: {path} → what a .onnx file is: {kind: known | draft | unsupported, model, assumptions, reason, alreadyInstalled}; installs nothing.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_install
tools.description: Install Face Model (command `faces.models.install`). Params: {path, acknowledged: true, activate?: true} → {installed, active: {embedder, enabled}} — copy a .onnx face recognition model into the models folder. `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown its licence (see inspect) and accepted it. Unless `activate` is false the model becomes the one in use and recognition is switched on; an earlier model stays installed.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_list
tools.description: Face Models (command `faces.models.list`). Params: {} → {dir, enabled, embedder, runtime, models: [{id, name, role, licence{name, commercial, url, notice}, provenance, source, sizeBytes, known, installed, selected}]}.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_remove
tools.description: Remove Face Model (command `faces.models.remove`). Params: {id} — delete an installed model.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_select
tools.description: Choose Face Recognition Model (command `faces.models.select`). Params: {id: installed recogniser | null}.

tools.name: cmd_faces_models_test
tools.description: Test Face Model (command `faces.models.test`). Params: {id} → {ok, result: {loadMs, embedMs, dimension, checks}} — load an installed recognition model and check it gives sensible faces; needs the recognition runtime.

tools.name: cmd_faces_nameFaces
tools.description: Name Faces (command `faces.nameFaces`). Params: {faces: [{photo, index}], name} → {named, photos} — name (or, with a null or empty name, clear) many face regions as one undoable step; the sidecar is not touched.

tools.name: cmd_faces_person
tools.description: Faces of a Person (command `faces.person`). Params: {name, more?: 120} → {name, total, confirmed: [{photo, index, rect}], more: [{photo, index, rect, score}], ready, pendingPhotos} — the faces named `name` across the library, and the unnamed faces that look most like them (best first, already embedded ones only, once recognition is on); confirm one with `faces.setName`.

tools.name: cmd_faces_pump
tools.description: Index Faces in the Background (command `faces.pump`). Params: {pace?: pause | light | normal | full} → {active, inFlight, pendingPhotos, indexedFaces, searchedPhotos, workers} — cheap to call every frame: takes in what the background workers have finished and gives them the next photos, as many at once as the pace allows (none when paused, one when light, half the machine's threads when normal, four fifths when full); inactive until face recognition is on in Settings with a model chosen.

tools.name: cmd_faces_setName
tools.description: Name Face (command `faces.setName`). Params: {id?, index, name} — name a face region (null or empty clears it); undoable; the sidecar is not touched.

tools.name: cmd_faces_suggest
tools.description: Suggest Names for Faces (command `faces.suggest`). Params: {ids?, threshold?, margin?, budgetMs?} → {photos: [{id, faces: [{index, suggestion: {name, score, runnerUp} | null, candidates: [{name, score}]}]}]} — who the unnamed faces in these photos might be, from the faces already named in the library. Only suggestions: nothing is named.

tools.name: cmd_faces_unnamed
tools.description: Unnamed Faces (command `faces.unnamed`). Params: {limit?: 600} → {total, faces: [{photo, index, rect, view, suggestion: {name, score} | null}], ordered, ready} — the faces nobody has named; with recognition running, look-alikes are next to each other and a face the named ones recognise carries the name they suggest. `view` is the box to show the face by. Name them with `faces.nameFaces`.

tools.name: cmd_filter_applyPreset
tools.description: Apply Filter Preset (command `filter.applyPreset`). Params: {name} — replaces the current filter → {photos}.

tools.name: cmd_filter_deletePreset
tools.description: Delete Filter Preset (command `filter.deletePreset`). Params: {name}.

tools.name: cmd_filter_presets
tools.description: Filter Presets (command `filter.presets`). Params: {} → [{name, filter}].

tools.name: cmd_filter_savePreset
tools.description: Save Filter Preset (command `filter.savePreset`). Params: {name} — the current filter (library.filter), saved with the library.

tools.name: cmd_folder_create
tools.description: New Folder on Disk (command `folder.create`). Params: {parent, name} — create a folder on disk inside `parent` (refused if the name is taken); one undo step (undo removes it again while it is empty) → {path}.

tools.name: cmd_folder_label
tools.description: Set Folder Color Label (command `folder.label`). Params: {path, label: red|yellow|green|blue|purple|none} — give a folder of the library (one its photos were imported from, see library.folders) a colour label, or take it off (also once its photos are gone); one undo step. The label follows the folder when it is renamed or moved with folder.rename / folder.move → {path, label}.

tools.name: cmd_folder_move
tools.description: Move Folder (command `folder.move`). Params: {path, into: destination folder} — move a folder on disk into another and relink the photos in it; one undo step (undo moves it back, refused if the old place is taken) → {path, relinked}.

tools.name: cmd_folder_rename
tools.description: Rename Folder (command `folder.rename`). Params: {path, name} — rename a folder on disk (its files and sidecars go along) and relink the photos in it; one undo step (undo renames it back, refused if the old name is taken) → {path, relinked}.

tools.name: cmd_folder_scanChanges
tools.description: Scan Folder for Changes (command `folder.scanChanges`). Params: {path, disk?: bool (a whole disk or share, or a folder holding disks)} — compare a folder of the library (and the folders inside it) with the disk; changes nothing → {path, new: [{path, name, format, …}] files the library doesn't have, duplicates: files whose content it already has, unreadable: [{path, error}], missing: [{id, path}] photos whose file is gone, moved: [{id, from, to}] photos whose file is elsewhere in the folder (same content), metadata: [{id, path}] photos whose XMP sidecar was saved after they came in or were last edited here and says something the library doesn't}.

tools.name: cmd_folder_synchronize
tools.description: Synchronize Folder (command `folder.synchronize`). Params: {path, disk?: bool, scanned?: bool, importNew?: true, relinkMoved?: true, removeMissing?: false, readMetadata?: false} — bring a folder of the library up to date with the disk (see folder.scanChanges): import its new files in place, relink photos whose file was renamed or moved within it, move photos whose file is gone to Recently Deleted, read XMP sidecars saved by other apps (the sidecar wins); acts on the last folder.scanChanges of the folder while it is current (the folder's photos unchanged), else scans again — or, with `scanned: true`, refuses; one undo step, no file is touched → {imported, relinked, removed, read, failed: [[path, error]]}.

tools.name: cmd_geometry_guides
tools.description: Guided Upright Guides (command `geometry.guides`). Params: {guides: [[x0,y0,x1,y1], …] (≤ 4, normalized coords of the lens-corrected image), add?: bool (append one guide, dropping the oldest beyond 4)} — switches Upright to Guided.

tools.name: cmd_geometry_upright
tools.description: Upright (command `geometry.upright`). Params: {mode: off|auto|guided|level|vertical|full} — analyses the photo (line segments → vanishing points) and stores the correction; run again to update after lens changes.

tools.name: cmd_history_clear
tools.description: Clear History (command `history.clear`). Params: {} — keeps the current settings as the only step.

tools.name: cmd_history_list
tools.description: List History (command `history.list`). Params: {id?} — returns {history: labels oldest first, cursor: index of the step the settings are at (later steps can be returned to), versions}.

tools.name: cmd_history_next
tools.description: Next History Step (command `history.next`). Params: {} — steps the History cursor forward one step.

tools.name: cmd_history_previous
tools.description: Previous History Step (command `history.previous`). Params: {} — steps the History cursor back one step.

tools.name: cmd_history_restore
tools.description: Go to History Step (command `history.restore`). Params: {index} — loads that step's settings and moves the History cursor there; later steps stay listed until a new edit.

tools.name: cmd_journal_list
tools.description: Command Journal (command `journal.list`). Params: {limit?}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_create
tools.description: Create Keyword (command `keyword.create`). Params: {name, parent?: keyword | null (default: the default parent; null = the top level), synonyms?, includeOnExport?, exportContaining?, exportSynonyms?, person?, addToSelected?: bool, ids?} → {keyword}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_delete
tools.description: Delete Keyword (command `keyword.delete`). Params: {keyword} — removes it (and the keywords below it) from every photo.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_deleteSet
tools.description: Delete Keyword Set (command `keyword.deleteSet`). Params: {name}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_edit
tools.description: Edit Keyword (command `keyword.edit`). Params: {keyword, name?: its new name (one level), synonyms?, includeOnExport?, exportContaining?, exportSynonyms?, person?} — what isn't given keeps its value.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_export
tools.description: Export Keywords (command `keyword.export`). Params: {path?} — the keyword list as a file (Lightroom Classic's format, which Capture One, Photo Supreme and Bridge read) → {keywords, captureOneRefuses: keywords with ; , < > that Capture One's importer refuses, unwritable: keywords left out because the format can't hold them (a name in brackets or braces, a line break, deeper than 64 levels; a synonym as "path {synonym}"), text when there is no path}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_import
tools.description: Import Keywords (command `keyword.import`). Params: {path | text} — a keyword list (Lightroom Classic's format, also Capture One's and Photo Supreme's Formatted Vocabulary File): adds the keywords the library doesn't have, gives those it has the list's synonyms; one undo step → {added, updated}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_info
tools.description: Keyword Info (command `keyword.info`). Params: {keyword} → {path, listed, count, synonyms, includeOnExport, exportContaining, exportSynonyms, person}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_list
tools.description: Keywords (command `keyword.list`). Params: {} → [{name, path, count, children}] keyword tree (`a|b|c` keywords are hierarchical).

tools.name: cmd_keyword_merge
tools.description: Merge Keywords (command `keyword.merge`). Params: {from: [keyword], into: keyword} — replaces each `from` keyword (children included) with `into` on every photo.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_move
tools.description: Move Keyword (command `keyword.move`). Params: {keyword, parent: keyword | null (the top level), merge?: bool} — with the keywords below it; onto a name that is taken only with `merge: true`.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_purgeUnused
tools.description: Purge Unused Keywords (command `keyword.purgeUnused`). Params: {} — takes off the keyword list the keywords no photo has → {purged}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_rename
tools.description: Rename Keyword (command `keyword.rename`). Params: {from, to} — on every photo, children included (`a` → `b` renames `a|x` to `b|x`); renaming onto an existing keyword merges them.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_saveSet
tools.description: Save Keyword Set (command `keyword.saveSet`). Params: {name, keywords?: [up to 9, "" = an empty slot] (default: the renamed set's, else the current nine), replace?: the set it renames, new?: refuse a name another set has} — replaces a set of that name (or `replace`, in its place) and makes it current.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_setDefaultParent
tools.description: Put New Keywords Inside (command `keyword.setDefaultParent`). Params: {keyword: keyword | null} — the parent keyword.create puts new keywords inside (null: the top level).

tools.name: cmd_keyword_sets
tools.description: Keyword Sets (command `keyword.sets`). Params: {} → {sets: [{name, keywords}], current, keywords: the nine ⌥1–⌥9 apply}.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_suggest
tools.description: Keyword Suggestions (command `keyword.suggest`). Params: {prefix?: typed text, ids?, limit?: 12} → keywords to suggest for the photos (co-occurring / most used, or matching the prefix).

tools.name: cmd_keyword_toggleFromSet
tools.description: Toggle Keyword from Set (command `keyword.toggleFromSet`). Params: {index: 1..9, ids?} — the set's keyword N: added to the target photos, or removed when they all have it.

tools.name: cmd_keyword_useSet
tools.description: Use Keyword Set (command `keyword.useSet`). Params: {name} ("Recent Keywords" = the recently added ones).

tools.name: cmd_label_applySet
tools.description: Apply Color Label Set (command `label.applySet`). Params: {name} — use a set's label names (undoable).

tools.name: cmd_label_deleteSet
tools.description: Delete Color Label Set (command `label.deleteSet`). Params: {name} — user sets only.

tools.name: cmd_label_names
tools.description: Color Label Names (command `label.names`). Params: {} → [{label, name, custom}].

tools.name: cmd_label_saveSet
tools.description: Save Color Label Set (command `label.saveSet`). Params: {name} — save the current label names as a set (replaces a user set of that name).

tools.name: cmd_label_setNames
tools.description: Edit Color Label Names (command `label.setNames`). Params: {names: {red?: name|null, yellow?, green?, blue?, purple?}} — null or empty restores the colour's name.

tools.name: cmd_label_sets
tools.description: Color Label Sets (command `label.sets`). Params: {} → {sets: [{name, names: [red, yellow, green, blue, purple], builtin}], current: name|null}.

tools.name: cmd_library_autoImport
tools.description: Auto Import Settings (command `library.autoImport`). Params: {folder?: path | null (off), copy?: bool (copy into the library's Originals, else add in place), album?: name | null} — a watched folder whose new photos are added as they arrive (library.autoImportScan; the app scans every few seconds) → the settings.

tools.name: cmd_library_autoImportScan
tools.description: Auto Import Now (command `library.autoImportScan`). Params: {listing?: [[path, size]] (the folder as listed by the caller, e.g. on a worker thread), start?: bool (false: return the `library.import` params as `import` instead of importing)} — add the watched folder's new photos (files the library doesn't have yet; partial / still-copying files wait for the next scan) → {imported, folder, warnings?: [{path, code, profile?, mode?, fields?}], import?}.

tools.name: cmd_library_browse
tools.description: Browse Folder (command `library.browse`). Params: {path, subfolders?: bool} — show a folder's photos without adding them to the library (they're read in place; edits go to XMP sidecars) → {path, photos, new}.

tools.name: cmd_library_buildPreviews
tools.description: Build Previews (command `library.buildPreviews`). Params: {size?: standard (2048 px, or `edge`) | full (1:1), ids?, wait?: bool} — render the grid thumbnail and loupe view of the selected photos (else all in view) into the preview cache, in the background unless `wait` → {total, done, failed, running}.

tools.name: cmd_library_cancelPreviews
tools.description: Cancel Preview Build (command `library.cancelPreviews`). Params: {}.

tools.name: cmd_library_clearFilter
tools.description: Clear Filters (command `library.clearFilter`). Params: {}. Menu: View.

tools.name: cmd_library_clearPreviews
tools.description: Clear Preview Cache (command `library.clearPreviews`). Params: {}. Menu: File.

tools.name: cmd_library_compact
tools.description: Optimize Library (command `library.compact`). Params: {}. Menu: File.

tools.name: cmd_library_devices
tools.description: Cameras and Cards (command `library.devices`). Params: {} → [{name, path (its DCIM folder), root}] — mounted volumes with a DCIM folder.

tools.name: cmd_library_down
tools.description: Photo Below (command `library.down`). Params: {rows?: n (photos to move forward; default 1, the grid passes the distance to the cell below)}. Shortcut: Down.

tools.name: cmd_library_emptyRecentlyDeleted
tools.description: Empty Recently Deleted (command `library.emptyRecentlyDeleted`). Params: {} → {deleted} — removes every photo in Recently Deleted from the library (files on disk stay). Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_library_filter
tools.description: Filter (command `library.filter`). Params: partial Filter: {text?, rating?, ratingOp?: atLeast|exactly|atMost, flag?: pick|reject|none|null, label?, kind?, merged?: hdr|panorama|hdrPanorama|any, edited?, date?, libraryFolder?: a path from library.folders, keyword?, person?, camera?}.

tools.name: cmd_library_findMissing
tools.description: Find Missing Photos (command `library.findMissing`). Params: {folder} — relink every missing photo whose file is somewhere in the folder: same name and size (and content, when the library knows its hash), or — renamed — same size and content; or {found, missing, ambiguous} — relink what a search already found (the app searches on a worker thread; photos relinked meanwhile and files now in use are skipped) → {found: [{id, from, to, by: name|content}], missing, ambiguous: [{id, from, candidates}] (several same-name candidates and no hash to tell them apart: skipped)}.

tools.name: cmd_library_findSimilar
tools.description: Find Similar Photos (command `library.findSimilar`). Params: {id?, similarity?: 0..1 (0.8), filter?: bool (true)} — photos that look like the active one (composition and tones), most similar first; filters the view to them (Clear Filters to go back) → {photos: [{id, similarity}]}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_library_folders
tools.description: Library Folders (command `library.folders`). Params: {} → [{name, path, count, own, volume, selectable, label?, children}] the disks and the folders the library's photos were imported from, with photo counts (subfolders included in `count`); show one with library.source {kind: libraryFolder, path} (rows with selectable false only open).

tools.name: cmd_library_forgetLocal
tools.description: Forget Unchanged Local Photos (command `library.forgetLocal`). Params: {dryRun?: bool, days?: n (default: the library preference, 0 = never)} — remove Local (browsed, not added) photos nobody changed, of folders not browsed for `days`, from the catalog; files and sidecars stay, browsing the folder again brings them back; not an undo step → {local, forgotten, keptRecent, keptTouched, keptInUse, foldersStamped, days, dryRun}.

tools.name: cmd_library_groups
tools.description: Date Groups (command `library.groups`). Params: {by?: day|month|year (default: the sort's grouping; auto = day)} → [{key, label, start, count}] date headers of the grid.

tools.name: cmd_library_import
tools.description: Import Photos (command `library.import`). Params: {paths: [file or folder (recursive)], mode?: add|copy|move (add = reference the files in place; copy = into the library's Originals/YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD/; move = as copy, then each original and its XMP sidecars are removed from the source — only after the copy is verified (a hard link on the same volume, else copied, synced and compared byte for byte) and its catalog record is saved; failed, duplicate and unchecked files keep their sources; a taken name gets -1, -2…; undo removes the photos from the library but leaves the files at the destination), destination?: folder for copies / moves, organize?: date (YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD) | month (YYYY/YYYY-MM) | flat | a folder template, e.g. `{date:%Y}/{date:%Y%m%d}` → 2026/20260114 (the template's `/` make the folders, each level expanded with the rename tokens and made a safe folder name: never outside the destination; must be relative, no `..`; a level with missing metadata is `unknown`) — dated by capture time, else the import time, rename?: file-name template for copies, original extension added (tokens: {name} {num} {seq} {seq:N} {date} {date:%Y%m%d} {folder} {camera} {lens} {iso} {rating} {title} {creator} {ext}; photo.renameTokens explains each; blank = keep names), renameStart?: 1, metadataPreset?: name, dng?: bool (copy raws as DNG; copy only), local?: bool (browsing: the photos stay out of the library, like library.browse; not with move), album?: albumId, albumName?: new album, preset?: presetId, keywords?: [..], onDeleted?: restore|skip|fresh (a file that is in Recently Deleted: restore (default) = bring the photo back with its edits — relinked to the file when its own is gone, skip = leave it there and say so, fresh = delete the trashed record and import the file as new)} → {imported, duplicates: [{path, existing, reason, existingDeleted?}], restored?: [photoId], failed, warnings?: [{path, code: cameraProfile|uprightGeometry|unmappedXmp, profile?, mode?: off|auto|level|vertical|full|guided|unknown, fields?}], moved?: [{from, to, sidecars?}], kept?: [{path, reason}] (move: sources left in place and why), album?}. Menu: File. Shortcut: Cmd+Shift+I.

tools.name: cmd_library_importLightroom
tools.description: Import Lightroom Catalog (command `library.importLightroom`). Params: {path: .lrcat, updateExisting?: false}; direct import of paths, ratings, flags, metadata, keywords, collections, virtual copies & mapped edits. Archives source settings/history first. Existing edited photos are preserved unless updateExisting=true; source catalog is read-only..

tools.name: cmd_library_importPreview
tools.description: Review Import (command `library.importPreview`). Params: {paths: [file or folder (recursive)]} → {candidates: [{path, name, format, kind, width, height, fileSize, captured, duplicate?: path|content, existing?, error?, previewOnly?: why a raw can only be shown from its embedded preview}], duplicates, scanned} — nothing is added.

tools.name: cmd_library_info
tools.description: Library Info (command `library.info`). Params: {}.

tools.name: cmd_library_inspectLightroom
tools.description: Inspect Lightroom Catalog (command `library.inspectLightroom`). Params: {path: .lrcat} → {photos, collections, missing, warnings}; read-only, no Lightroom required.

tools.name: cmd_library_memory
tools.description: Memory Usage (command `library.memory`). Params: {} — bytes held by each cache (decoded sources, rendered previews, GPU buffers; heap when instrumented).

tools.name: cmd_library_missing
tools.description: Missing Photos (command `library.missing`). Params: {} → [{id, path}] — photos whose original file isn't where the library expects it.

tools.name: cmd_library_next
tools.description: Next Photo (command `library.next`). Params: {}. Shortcut: Right.

tools.name: cmd_library_preferences
tools.description: Library Preferences (command `library.preferences`). Params: {import?: {rawPreset?: presetId|"default", otherPreset?: presetId|"default", perCamera?: bool, cameras?: [{camera: "Make Model", preset: presetId|null}], copyright?: text, creator?: text (given to imported photos without one)}, camera?: {camera, preset?, remove?: bool}, cacheMb?: n (0 = default), forgetLocalDays?: n (forget untouched Local photos of folders not browsed for n days; 0 = never)} — develop defaults applied on import (raws / other images / per camera) and the thumbnail cache size, saved with the library → {xmp, import, cacheMb, forgetLocalDays, persistent}.

tools.name: cmd_library_previewProgress
tools.description: Preview Build Progress (command `library.previewProgress`). Params: {} → {total, done, failed, repaired, running, cancelled, what, error} | null.

tools.name: cmd_library_previous
tools.description: Previous Photo (command `library.previous`). Params: {}. Shortcut: Left.

tools.name: cmd_library_removeFolder
tools.description: Remove Folder from Library (command `library.removeFolder`). Params: {path, disk?: bool} — move the library photos imported from this folder (and the folders inside it) to Recently Deleted; one undo step, no file is touched. A whole disk or share (`/Volumes/nas`, `C:\`, `\\srv\share`) goes only with `disk: true`, the startup disk never → {removed}.

tools.name: cmd_library_select
tools.description: Select Photos (command `library.select`). Params: {ids: [id], active?: id, mode?: replace|add|toggle|range} — every id must be a photo of the library.

tools.name: cmd_library_selectAll
tools.description: Select All (command `library.selectAll`). Params: {}. Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+A.

tools.name: cmd_library_selectBy
tools.description: Select by Flag, Rating or Label (command `library.selectBy`). Params: {flag?: pick|reject|none, rating?: 0..5, ratingOp?: gte|eq|lte (default gte), label?: red|…|none, add?: bool (extend the selection)} — among the photos in view.

tools.name: cmd_library_selectNone
tools.description: Deselect All (command `library.selectNone`). Params: {}. Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+Shift+A.

tools.name: cmd_library_shuffle
tools.description: Reshuffle (command `library.shuffle`). Params: {seed?: 0..2^53-1} — sort at random; without `seed` a new shuffle each time. Menu: View › Sort.

tools.name: cmd_library_smartPreviews
tools.description: Build Smart Previews (command `library.smartPreviews`). Params: {ids?, discard?: bool, background?: bool} — build (or discard) the smart previews of the selected photos (else all in view): compact proxies in the library that keep photos editable and exportable (at proxy size) while their originals are offline; a damaged proxy (cut short) is rebuilt → {built, repaired, removed, failed}; with background (the app's menu) the files are read and written on a worker thread → {total, done, failed, repaired, running, what} like library.buildPreviews (progress: library.previewProgress, stop: library.cancelPreviews).

tools.name: cmd_library_smartPreviewsLocation
tools.description: Smart Previews Location (command `library.smartPreviewsLocation`). Params: {path?: absolute folder, reset?: bool, existing?: move|leave|discard} — without path/reset: where this library keeps its smart previews → {path, default, custom, available, count, bytes}. With path (or reset = back to `Smart Previews` in the library): use that folder instead (must exist or have an existing parent, and accept writes; never falls back to another drive). Smart previews already in the old folder need `existing`: move them, leave them (build again), or discard them → also {handled, failed}.

tools.name: cmd_library_sort
tools.description: Sort (command `library.sort`). Params: {key?: captureDate|importDate|editDate|fileName|rating|fileSize|random, ascending?: bool, group?: auto|none|day|month|year, seed?: u64 (the shuffle `random` gives)}. Menu: View › Sort.

tools.description: Save Metadata Preset (command `metadata.savePreset`). tools.description: Assisted Culling (command `photo.analyze`). tools.name: cmd_photo_autoTagTracklog
tools.description: Auto-Tag Photos from Tracklog (command `photo.autoTagTracklog`). Params: {path?: GPX file | gpx?: GPX text, ids?, offset?: camera clock's UTC offset for photos whose capture time has no zone (`+02:00`, or hours; default UTC), maxGap?: seconds (600), replace?: bool (also photos that already have GPS), dryRun?: bool} → {tagged, interpolated, nearest, skipped: {noTime, outside, hasGps}, assumedUtc, points, start, end, photos: [{id, gps, match}]} — positions from the track log by capture time; one undo step.

tools.name: cmd_photo_convertToDng
tools.description: Convert to DNG (command `photo.convertToDng`). Params: {ids?} — write each raw photo as a lossless DNG next to it (settings embedded) and relink the photo to it; originals are kept → {converted: [{id, path, original}], skipped}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_photo_copyMetadata

tools.name: cmd_photo_decreaseRating

tools.name: cmd_photo_editExternal
tools.description: Edit Copy for External Editor (command `photo.editExternal`). tools.name: cmd_photo_flag
tools.description: Set Flag (command `photo.flag`). Params: {flag: pick|reject|none, ids?, advance?: bool}. Menu: Photo › Set Flag.

tools.name: cmd_photo_label

tools.description: Move to Folder (command `photo.moveToFolder`). tools.name: cmd_photo_pasteMetadata
tools.description: Paste Metadata (command `photo.pasteMetadata`). Params: {ids?, fields?: [title|caption|copyright|copyrightStatus|usageTerms|copyrightUrl|creator|location|keywords] (default: all copied)}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_photo_rate

tools.description: Read Metadata from File (command `photo.readMetadataFromFile`). tools.name: cmd_photo_reject

tools.description: Reload from Disk (command `photo.reload`). Menu: Photo.

tools.name: cmd_photo_removeRegion
tools.description: Remove Face Box (command `photo.removeRegion`). The XMP sidecar is never rewritten for this, even with auto-write on, so reading the metadata from the file brings the region back.

tools.name: cmd_stack_toggle
tools.description: Expand/Collapse Stack (command `stack.toggle`). Params: {ids?, collapsed?: bool}. Menu: Photo › Stack. Shortcut: S.

tools.name: cmd_stack_ungroup
tools.description: Ungroup Stack (command `stack.ungroup`). Params: {ids?}. Menu: Photo › Stack. Shortcut: Cmd+Shift+G.

tools.name: cmd_version_create
tools.description: Create Version (command `version.create`). Params: {name?}. Menu: Photo. Shortcut: Cmd+Shift+S.

tools.name: cmd_version_delete
tools.description: Delete Version (command `version.delete`). Params: {index}.

tools.name: cmd_version_rename
tools.description: Rename Version (command `version.rename`). Params: {index, name}.

tools.name: cmd_version_restore
tools.description: Restore Version (command `version.restore`). Params: {index}.

tools.name: cmd_version_update
tools.description: Update Version with Current Settings (command `version.update`). Params: {index}.

tools.name: command_batch
tools.description: Run several commands in order: {steps: [{id, params?}], stop_on_error?: true}. Returns {completed, failed, results: [{ok, result | error}]}.

tools.name: command_list
tools.description: Every command (engine + UI when connected) with id, label, menu, shortcut, parameter doc and whether it is enabled now. Each id is also callable as tool `cmd_<id with . replaced by _>` or via command_run.

tools.name: command_run
tools.description: Run any LightCraft command by id with JSON params (see command_list for ids and parameter docs), e.g. {id: "photo.rate", params: {rating: 4}}.

tools.name: crop
tools.description: Set the crop of the active photo: `rect` [x0,y0,x1,y1] in normalized coordinates (0..1, origin top-left) of the straightened frame, `angle` in degrees. `reset: true` clears it. Give at least one of them.

tools.name: doc_inspect
tools.description: The library as JSON: current source, filter, sort, selection, active photo and undo/redo labels (library.state) plus counts (catalog.stats).

tools.name: export
tools.description: Render and write photos. Give `path` (one photo; format from the extension unless `format` is set) or `dir` (batch, file names from `naming`).

tools.name: get_develop
tools.description: The full develop settings JSON of a photo (white balance, light, color, curves, mixer, grading, effects, crop, masks, spots…).

tools.name: import
tools.description: Add image/raw files to the library. Folders are scanned recursively for photos; relative paths resolve against the server's working directory. The first imported photo becomes active. Returns the new photo ids.

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: Every command (engine + UI when connected) with id, label, menu, shortcut, parameter doc and whether it is enabled now. Each id is also callable as tool `cmd_<id with . replaced by _>` or via run_command.

tools.name: list_controls
tools.description: Every develop slider (id like `light.exposure`, label, section, min, max, default, current value) for the active photo.

tools.name: query_photos
tools.description: List photos (id, file name, size, rating, flag, edited…). Without filter/sort: the current library view.

tools.name: render_photo
tools.description: Render a photo with its current develop settings (cropped) and return it as an image so you can look at the result.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Render a photo with its current develop settings (cropped) and return it as an image (`max_side` is the long edge; does not change selection or save a file).

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run any LightCraft command by id with JSON params (see list_commands for ids and parameter docs), e.g. {command: "photo.rate", params: {rating: 4}}.

tools.name: select_photos
tools.description: Set the selection; the active photo (the one develop tools edit) is `active` or the first id.

tools.name: set_develop
tools.description: Edit a photo (one undo step each for values and settings). `values` sets sliders by control id (see list_controls), e.g. {"light.exposure": 0.7, "light.contrast": 20}. `settings` deep-merges a partial develop-settings JSON (as returned by get_develop).
